test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Speed of six bikes T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 and T6 are compared. Speed of T6 is more than only three bikes. No two bikes have same speed. Speed of T4 is more than T2 but less than T6. Speed of T3 is not less than T5. Speed of T2 and T5 is not least. How many bikes have less speed than T3?
solution:
Given: Six bikes T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 and T6.

1) Speed of T6 is more than only three bikes.

__ > __ > T6 > __ > __ > __ 

2) Speed of T4 is more than T2 but less than T6.

3) Speed of T2 and T5 is not least.

__ > __ > T6 > T4 > T2 > __ 

4) Speed of T3 is not less than T5.

T3 > T5 > T6 > T4 > T2 > __ 

And, T1 is placed at the remaining place.

T3 > T5 > T6 > T4 > T2 > T1

Here, there are '5' bikes have less speed than T3.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
